# Martín Ratti - Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Martín Ratti, showcasing Full Stack development skills with a focus on performance and modern UI design. Built with Astro, TypeScript, and React.

## Project Details

This website serves as a professional portfolio and technical demonstration. It includes sections for:

- **About Me:** Professional background and education.

- **Stack:**

    - **Frontend:** Astro, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS.

    - **Backend:** Node.js, Express, Java (Servlets/JSP), .NET 8 (WebAPI).

    - **Desktop:** .NET WinForms, Python (Automation/OCR).

    - **Data:** MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Prisma.

    - **DevOps/Tools:** Docker, Git, NPM Workspaces.

    - **Methodologies:** Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Clean Architecture.

- **Projects:** Highlighted works like Zenith POS, PCFIX, and Tracker UTN Sistemas.

- **Contact:** Links to email, LinkedIn, and GitHub.

## Other Projects (Context for AI)

> This section allows the AI to answer questions about Martin's other repositories.

### [PCFIX-Baru](https://github.com/martin-ratti/PCFIX-Baru)

- **Description:** E-Commerce Monorepo designed for scale. Orchestrates a robust API and a hybrid Frontend.

- **Tech Stack:** Astro Server Islands, React, Node.js API, Docker, NPM Workspaces.

- **Key Features:** Instant purchase experience, admin management system, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, End-to-End testing with Playwright.

---

### [Zenith POS (Landing & Desktop App)](https://github.com/martin-ratti/Landing-Zenith)

- **Description:** Comprehensive commercial Point of Sale ecosystem. Consists of a high-performance Windows desktop application and a modern, SEO-optimized landing page.

- **Tech Stack:** Desktop: C# (.NET Framework 4.0), WinForms (MVP pattern), SQLite, Dapper. Packaging: Inno Setup 6. Landing: Astro 5, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript.

- **Key Features:** Clean Architecture (Onion), White-label customization (ThemeManager via config.json), Hardware ID security (Machine Binding), 100% Offline operation, ESC/POS thermal printing support (58mm/80mm), Accounts Receivable (Cuentas Corrientes), and shift/cash flow reconciliation.

---

### [TicketApp - Marketplace de Entradas & Eventos](https://github.com/valenpeppi/BackEnd-Venta-de-Entradas)
- **Description:** Comprehensive full-stack event management and ticketing Marketplace developed with Valentín Peppino and Gianlucas Zabaleta for UTN FRRo.
- **Tech Stack:** Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Context API, Vite, Axios, jsPDF. Backend: Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, MySQL, Zod, Nodemailer. Security: JWT with BOOT_ID, Google reCAPTCHA v2, Helmet. Testing: Vitest, Jest, Supertest, Playwright. AI: OpenRouter (DeepSeek/Gemma).
- **Key Features:** Dynamic real-time stadium seat selection, Stripe Checkout with async webhooks, AI assistant (TicketBot) and automated admin reply suggestions, client-side PDF tickets, transactional emails, and multi-role dashboards.

---

### [ProyectoIDE-BuyJugador](https://github.com/agussantinelli/ProyectoIDE-BuyJugador)

- **Description:** Multi-layered inventory and commercial management system for gaming and tech retail, developed with Tomas Levrand and Agustín Santinelli for UTN.

- **Tech Stack:** Web: Blazor WebAssembly + Bootstrap. Desktop: WinForms. Backend: ASP.NET Core Web API (DTOs, Domain Services, Repositories). Database: SQL Server (EF Core + ADO.NET). Reporting: ScottPlot + PDFsharp.

- **Key Features:** 8-project layered architecture, shared ApiClient, JWT Authentication with CORS, synchronized dual clients, price history line graphs with vector PDF export, and sales-by-vendor analytics.

---

### [Tracker UTN Sistemas](https://github.com/martin-ratti/tracker-ing-sist)

- **Description:** Interactive web platform for tracking the Systems Engineering curriculum (UTN FRRo - Plan 2023).

- **Tech Stack:** Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Vite. Backend: Node.js, Express, Resend. Cloud: Firebase (Auth & Firestore). Testing: Vitest, Playwright.

- **Key Features:** Interactive prerequisite vis-network graph with critical path analysis, official academic exam calendar with automated 7-day email reminders, client-side PDF official transcript generation (jsPDF), dual-degree tracking (ADUSI & Engineering), and 5 dynamic themes.

---

### [MetinForge](https://github.com/martin-ratti/MetinForge)

- **Description:** Desktop application for Metin2 "farmers" to track repetitive tasks and assets.

- **Key Features:** Alchemy (Draconis) management, Fishing module analytics, Event/Tombola tracking, Floating Timer, Mass account import (.xlsx/.csv).

---

### [Extractor-OCR-Python](https://github.com/martin-ratti/Extractor-OCR-Python)

- **Description:** Professional desktop OCR tool that extracts text only from highlighted areas (Yellow, Green, Pink, Violet).

- **Tech Stack:** Python, Tesseract OCR, Clean Architecture.

- **Key Features:** Drag & drop interface, batch processing, intelligent color detection.

---

### [GitIgnore-Genius](https://github.com/martin-ratti/GitIgnore-Genius)

- **Description:** Desktop app to generate robust .gitignore files automatically by analyzing project structure.

- **Key Features:** Language/Framework detection, Smart generation, Drag & drop.

---

### [ImpulsaMe - Java Crowdfunding](https://github.com/agussantinelli/ImpulsaMe-Java.git)

- **Description:** Crowdfunding web platform built with a 3-tier MVC architecture in Java EE, Apache Tomcat, and MySQL, developed with Joaquín Peralta and Agustín Santinelli.

- **Tech Stack:** Java Servlets, JSP, JSTL, Apache Tomcat, MySQL (DAO pattern & raw JDBC), Maven, Stripe API (Checkout Sessions), BCrypt.

- **Key Features:** Campaign lifecycle (Pending -> Active), Stripe Donations in ARS with UUID idempotency keys, RBAC security filter (AuthFilter), backer-only comments with soft delete, and multipart image uploads with UUID filenames.

The site is designed with a "performance first" approach using Astro 5, ensuring fast load times. It features a responsive Glassmorphism design with dark mode and internationalization (English/Spanish).
